label: late original-phase steps (t=5-8), strongest on input 2 or after p
explanation: Fires only in the last few steps of the original phase (orig_idx 5-8, to_go 0-2, so mostly L>=7). 99.5% of activation mass is there, a trace is on <DEL>, and it never fires in the copy phase. Even in that window it fires on only about 5% of steps. Within the window the strongest activations are on input token 2 (7.4x lift, 34% of mass; the top examples are almost all 2) or right after p (prev_tok p, 20% of mass). Weaker boosts come from g, 3, o, t and digit-heavy sequences. Top examples often have prefixes containing o/p/q/j/u. The predicate (late original phase AND (input 2 OR prev p)) gets dev F1 0.31 and mass recall 0.50. Many weak activations on other tokens are unexplained, so the feature looks like a distributed hidden-state code rather than a clean token rule. Never fires at t<4.
